name: Emera Incorporated Preferred Shares (EMA.PR.H)
summary: Emera Incorporated is a Halifax-based energy and utilities firm that was established in 1998. It produces, transmits and supplies electricity using facilities fuelled by biomass, petroleum coke, solar, wind, hydro, oil, natural gas and coal. It also takes part in the natural gas market, handling the buying, transport, distribution and selling of it.
